<div class="card-body">
'''Moment Of Triumph''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]]<nowiki> </nowiki>([[Lost Interrupt]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].

<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">目前の勝利</span>

<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">ターキンが単独で戦闘を防衛しているなら、戦闘運命数を２回引いて足せる。ターキンでなく、エイリアンが単独で戦闘を防衛しているなら、戦闘運命数を１回引いて足せる。</span>

<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">アウターリムの冷酷な支配者グランドモフ・ターキンは、デス・スターでオルデランを破壊し、恐怖による支配を打ち立てた。</span>''



<nowiki />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Victory before one's eyes.

'''Card text:''' If Tarkin is defending a battle alone, draw and add two battle destiny. If an alien, rather than Tarkin, is defending a battle alone, draw and add one battle destiny.

'''Lore:''' Grand Moff Tarkin, a ruthless ruler of the Outer Rim, destroyed Alderaan with the Death Star and established rule by fear.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese card explicitly says to draw the added battle destiny and describes the alien alternative as an alien rather than Tarkin. The English printing says to add battle destiny in either case.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Moment Of Triumph]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="psa">[https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/tcg/company-sets/1997-decipher-star-wars-ccg-premiere-japanese/imagegallery/724984 Japanese Premiere collector gallery], PSA; [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/186921614/pHeW8UiHgUqjexh22_GiCA.jpg Moment Of Triumph photograph].</ref>
